As an antisocial person, it's understandable that you prefer to spend most of your time alone and may not feel comfortable in large, loud social gatherings like weddings. It's also reasonable to expect your parents to respect your boundaries and not force you to attend events that make you uncomfortable. You've communicated your feelings and needs clearly, and it's not fair that they're not listening to you. In this scenario, it's not about being an "asshole" for not wanting to attend the wedding, but rather about setting healthy boundaries and prioritizing your own well-being. It's okay to say no to social invitations, especially when they don't align with your personality or comfort level. It's worth noting that your parents should respect your autonomy and not guilt-trip or coerce you into attending events that make you uncomfortable. It's possible that they may not fully understand or appreciate your antisocial tendencies, but that doesn't mean they should disregard your feelings and boundaries.
